scripts.dev: (pnpm db || echo No database, running without it) && pnpm run /^dev:/
scripts.dev:frontend: pnpm --dir frontend install && pnpm --dir frontend dev
scripts.db: docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml up -d --wait && pnpm db:migrate
scripts.db:migrate: uv --directory backend run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml down --volumes && pnpm db
scripts.check: pnpm --dir frontend check && uv --directory backend run ruff check && uv --directory backend run ruff format --check
scripts.format: pnpm --dir frontend format && uv --directory backend run ruff check --fix && uv --directory backend run ruff format
